claims.claim: The archived simulated holdout return path has a Calmar ratio of approximately 1.33 under the primary elapsed-calendar-time convention.
claims.conditions: Nine-symbol equal-weight simulated net-return path, 2024-01-02 through 2026-07-06; not a prospective profitability claim.

claims.claim: The archived holdout summary reported a 55.24 percent mean of the nine per-symbol raw accuracies.
claims.conditions: Unweighted mean of the nine rounded per-symbol values over 628 sessions per symbol, 2024-01-02 through 2026-07-06. Raw accuracy alone is not treated as proof of forecast skill.

claims.claim: The historical metrics establish statistically validated alpha or predict future performance.
claims.conditions: The package reports a retrospective simulation with simplified costs over one holdout interval; it is neither a live-trading record nor a prospective validation.

claims.claim: The reported metrics were produced by a physical reservoir device.
claims.conditions: The reservoir and portfolio were simulated in software; no hardware experiment or execution test was conducted.

claims.claim: A public checkout can refit the historical market experiment from raw data.
claims.conditions: Restricted and source-derived market feature rows are not redistributed. Public code demonstrates the frozen method and can exactly replay metrics only when the separately retained hash-verified return artifact is supplied.
